title: AnemoCore
description: Pure-Rust (#![no_std] compatible) wind energy resource assessment, wake modeling, drivetrain prognostics, and KAM-VSG grid-forming control engine with PyO3 Python and R bindings, funded by the European Union Erasmus+ CBHE project ECO-WIND (Grant No. ERASMUS-EDU-2025-CBHE-101177220).
